directive.quote: Fix shared method and opposing DST/timezone controls while preserving original meaning and complete relevant event actions.

targets.role: Active shared RFC 5545 serializer, adapted from the original byte-identical port.

preserve: The host remains ORGANIZER and invitees remain ATTENDEE properties.
REQUEST creates or updates the same UID and CANCEL removes it with the existing status semantics.
A zero-duration DATE-TIME VEVENT omits DTEND so its end remains equal to DTSTART under RFC 5545 §3.6.1.
UTC DATE-TIME values, event text escaping and valid ASCII output remain stable where possible.
This public serializer uses synthetic fixtures only and performs no provider, account, email or grant writes.
allowed_deltas: Reject control characters in structural UID and email values before serialization.
Validate runtime method, sequence, timestamps, reject negative event duration, and validate reminder values before interpolation.
Omit DTEND for equal start and end timestamps to preserve zero-duration event semantics.
Escape CRLF, LF and lone CR in text values; encode CN parameter punctuation without creating a new property.
Fold serialized lines on Unicode code points using UTF-8 octet budgets.
banned_substitutions: Do not add arbitrary new length bounds or a package dependency.
Do not change the organizer or attendee role, UID update identity, or cancellation behavior.
Do not test by writing to a calendar, provider, email account or grant.

baseline.scope: In-place adaptation of the existing byte-identical Workshop copy. Its moved-from record identifies the original public source path and commit. No archive or new copy claim.
